phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic close-up of K'el's face, the matte polymer skin illuminated by the harsh glare of a passing artificial sun. His amber sensor eyes are focused intensely on a floating vector field display. The background is a blur of obsidian architecture and blinding plasma light. Subsurface circuitry glows through his cheek. He wears a high-collar interface suit of black data-glass. The atmosphere is tense, heavy with the responsibility of maintaining the simulation's physics. 8k, ray-traced reflections, cinematic drama.
